name: tau-ask
description: Lets the agent ask you questions and waits for your answers

tools.name: ask
tools.description:
Ask the person one to four questions and wait for their answers. Use it when you need a decision only they can make: a preference, a trade-off, which of several plans to follow, or something the request leaves open that you cannot settle from the code or a sensible default. Do not use it to ask whether to go on or whether a plan is ready.

Each question has a short header (at most 12 characters, shown as a tab) and two to four choices, each a short label and a description. The person can always write their own answer instead, so never offer an "Other". If you recommend a choice, put it first and end its label with "(Recommended)". Set multi_select when several choices can hold at once. A choice may carry a preview (Markdown, shown in a monospace box) when the person should compare concrete things, such as code or layouts; previews are only for questions where one choice is picked.

The result gives each question's answer and any note the person added to it, or says they declined.

questions.description: One to four questions, asked together.

header.description: A word or two for its tab, at most 12 characters: "Auth method".

multi_select.description: Whether several choices can be picked.

options.description: Two to four choices. The person can always write their own answer instead, so do not offer an "Other". Put a recommended choice first and end its label with "(Recommended)".

description.description: What picking it means, or what follows from it.

preview.description: Something to look at while the choice is in focus: a code snippet, a mockup, a diagram. Markdown, shown in a monospace box. Only for questions where one choice is picked.

question.description: The whole question, ending in a question mark.
